title: Cover marketing, support and testing yourself, without dropping product work
summary: In a small start-up, the PM often does support, testing and marketing too. Do them on purpose, learn from them, and protect time for product decisions.

beginner: List the jobs nobody owns yet, such as support, testing and launch posts.
Agree with the founders which ones you will cover for now.
Block time each week for discovery and planning so they don't disappear.
Use support conversations as research and write down what you learn.
Keep simple checklists for testing and launches so others can help.
intermediate: Timebox each extra job and review the split monthly.
Turn repeated support issues into backlog items.
Flag to the founders when a job needs a hire.
experienced: Design the first roles the product team needs next.
Hand over jobs with checklists and clear owners.
Keep the founders owning vision while you run product execution.

toolExamples.notion: Keep checklists for testing and launches in one place.
toolExamples.trello: Track support issues that should become backlog items.

definitionOfDone: Jobs you cover agreed with the founders
pitfalls: Not telling founders when the load is too high
Losing what customers say in support
